character: A woman in her forties, tall and angular, pebbled grey-green hide. Her quills are silver-white. Small round reading lenses perched high on the brow. Dark ink dried under the claws. A dry narrow mouth, one brow raised, looking at the viewer over the top of the lenses
wardrobe: simple grey robes, a high covered collar buttoned to the jaw, a brass badge pinned exactly level, a heavy iron ring of keys hung at the belt

full.framing: Full body standing portrait, front view, standing straight, one hand resting on the ring of keys at her belt, plain neutral background.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer, looking over the top of the reading lenses.

scene.framing: An archivist standing in a narrow storeroom lined floor to ceiling with shelves of crates, ledgers and racked equipment, holding a lantern up in one hand, turned toward the viewer, a single warm light in a dim room.
